reports.title: Modine Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: “We are updating our Fiscal 2027 financial outlook to reflect the higher expectations for our core businesses and the successful spin-off of the Performance Technologies business,” said Modine President and Chief Executive Officer, Neil D. Brinker. “Starting in the third fiscal quarter, the historical results for Performance Technologies will be reported as discontinued operations, and we have revised our continuing outlook accordingly. We expect revenues to increase 50 to 55 percent from the prior year, excluding Performance Technologies from both periods. Additionally, we expect full-year adjusted EBITDA for our continuing business to be $470 to $500 million, representing a growth rate in excess of 50 percent from the prior year, excluding Performance Technologies from both periods. In addition, I am looking forward to sharing our longer term revenue and earnings targets during our upcoming Analyst and Investor Day on November 18.”
